spans.notes: OLD_DESIGN: the earlier Pudgy look throughout: bright yellow feet and beaks, paler rose and periwinkle bodies, glossy shaded furniture with white highlights (round table and chair, door, ice-brick bed). Identity of the two penguins (an earlier-design Polly and Pax) is unplaced, but the drop stands on style. Five shots on a plain pale background, hard cuts at f58, f72, f93, f142: [0,58) the Polly-like penguin sits at a round table under a wall clock looking at a phone, then gets up and walks off right; [58,72) she stands with her back to us at a closed door; [72,93) wide: she comes through the door holding a phone; [93,142) over her shoulder she holds a phone out toward the Pax-like penguin sitting on a bed with his own phone; [142,226) she stands in front of the open door frowning, holding the phone. Camera not checked shot by shot (no span here could be kept). No meme caption or watermark seen

f226-239: the picture abruptly empties to the plain pale background with only a tiny yellow speck in the middle (the removed BOOM effect of this NOBOOM version, presumably); f240-277: pure black (every pixel 0) to the end
